# Wildflower Retreats

> Small-group slow travel weeks on the Black Sea coast of Georgia.

## About
- Website: https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app
- Focus: Slow travel retreats in and around Batumi for small groups of up to 12 guests.
- Location: Batumi, Adjara, Georgia.
- Season: May – October.
- Highlights: Sea swims, mountain canyons, botanical garden, architectural walks, supra dinners, and qvevri wine tastings.
- Note: This is a design and engineering demo site with fictional booking details.

## Navigation
- [Home](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#hero): Overview and introduction
- [The Retreat](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#camp): Philosophy and hosts
- [The Week](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#offer): Program, excursions and dining
- [Dates & Booking](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#shifts): Departure dates and reservations
- [Contact](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/#contacts): Get in touch
- [Privacy Policy](https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app/rules): Data handling rules
